newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares hit by correction.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares hit by correction.

text.p: Lithuanian shares slid on Tuesday as the market was hit by a correction but dealers said it would be short-term.
"Last week's rapid rise could not last long and the market calmed down to make corrections for a day or two," Arvydas Jacikevichius, a broker with Suprema brokerage, told Reuters.
The official list index was down to 1157.35 points by 19.63 points while the group index declined by 35.52 points to 2004.84 points.
Turnover on the central market amounted to 968,000 litas while block trades reached 1.116 million litas.
Four out of five shares on the elite official list were down with only Birzhu Milk gaining as it inched to 10.19 litas from 10.18 litas on tiny turnover of 17,000 litas.
Rokishkis Cheese was down to 51.99 litas from 55.00 litas in central market trade of 163,000 litas.
Dealers said that investors seemed to be turning their attention to the country's oil sector, which is widely regarded as a good long-term bet.
Mazheikiu Nafta jumped to 17.50 litas from 15.00 litas on 139,000 litas turnover on the central market
The state-run company, which has been slated for privatisation, reported on Tuesday a pre-tax profit of 30 million litas on 1.33 billion litas turnover for the first seven months of the year.
